coverage: Historical civilian/LCV production identity checkpoint plus all13 existing catalogue slugs. Selected contemporary OEM versions only; incomplete used-market engine tables.
excluded: Military MB/MA/M38/M715 and Ford GPW; prototypes CJ4/ForwardControl concepts/Recon announcements without established production.
Willys Aero and unrelated Willys passenger cars; heritage Wagon/Truck/Jeepster included explicitly with original manufacturer context.
Special equipment packages such as CJ Renegade/Golden Eagle and ZJ Grand Wagoneer trim are not independent lines.
gaps: Exact global production bounds differ from model years for early CJ, Jeepster, SJ trucks and regional assembly.
Historic CJ/DJ/FC and1990s–2010s European diesel/petrol engine tables remain to research.
Modern Wrangler selected row hasUS/global scope, not Czech homologation.
Renegade2020Dutch brochure has conflicting systemkW narrative154 vs190PS and inconsistent variant numbers; not imported into versions.
Photos being researched; search not exhaustive.
Two sourced2013 short WranglerCRD rows added; roof-height and slash-separated mass configurations remain unresolved rather than inferred.
WranglerJL selected stock photo shows whole vehicle, but its side margin is narrower than ideal; better-spaced replacement still desirable.
WJ start corrected from existing Europe-only1999 to source overall1998; regional periods recorded explicitly. Shared original line registry not edited.

Two further exact-file Wrangler candidates rejected: one tightly framed balloon-covered showroom vehicle, one earlier-generation vehicle despite2019 title. Selected JL stock photograph retains narrower-than-ideal side margin.

validation.checks: Unique production identities, scoped versions, exact Commons credits/aspects, indexed nulls and retained conflicts.
